metadata_caption: She almost burn’t the house down for a craving! 😅 backstory ::: During her pregnancy, Kay sometimes gets cravings. Usually, when she gets a craving, I will go and get the stuff and make it for her. This time, I was coming home from work, and she tried to cook a baked potato in the microwave. She put it in and set it for 5 minutes and left. She came back to smoke all over the apartment. She took out the burnt potato bag and soaked it in water. Then she got the smoke out with fans! 😂 I then showed up from work to her trying to finish cleaning out the microwave, to hide the evidence! 😂 I’m pretty sure we have microwaved potatoes before, so I am not sure what she did to make it catch fire! Either way, after she told me the story, we went down the road and got a baked potato! 😂 #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant
